justification: The [proof](https://cs.stackexchange.com/questions/156858/correctness-of-fips-186-4-square-test-algorithm) permits C=16, n=5, m=3, x_0=4. Then g(4)=(16+16)/8=4 and x_1=4, so k=1 is the first positive qualifying index, but g(x_0)>sqrt(C) is false. This genuine equality-case error differs from the ground truth’s final rounding error.
